The Elements of Style Is Ruining Your Writing (And Your Voice) 

The Elements of Style by Strunk & White isn’t just outdated—it’s actively harming your writing. In this video, I’ll show you how blindly following Strunk and White’s so-called writing rules is costing you opportunities, confidence, and connection with readers. If you’ve ever felt stifled by grammar “rules” or silenced by useless advice like “omit needless words,” then this video is your wake-up call.

What You’ll Learn:
 • Why The Elements of Style gets writing completely wrong;
 • How the “active voice only” rule is a trap (and when you should use passive voice);
 • The truth about split infinitives;
 • How Strunk & White break their own rules—repeatedly and unwittingly;
 • A smarter, clearer approach to writing style that actually helps you write better.

Say goodbye to writing like a robot. Say hello to writing with voice, clarity, and power.

I’m William, an English professor turned writing coach. I help entrepreneurs and thought leaders convert their expertise into books that resonate with readers and build audiences.
